basic_info.chief_complaint: Nausea from wearing maxillary removable dentures

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Nausea from wearing maxillary removable dentures

present_illness.present_illness: The patient reported that he had recently had nausea after wearing the maxillary removable tooth two years after it was repaired outside the hospital, and now he came to our hospital for treatment.

past_history.present_illness: The patient reported that he had recently had nausea after wearing the maxillary removable tooth two years after it was repaired outside the hospital, and now he came to our hospital for treatment.

oral_examination.oral_examination: The posterior edge of the maxillary removable denture has a long base, and the base at the dental arch reaches the maxillary tubercle. The adsorption is not strong and the fit is not good. The rest is no different. CBCT showed that the maxillary alveolar bone volume was acceptable.

treatment_plan.definitive: Implant fixed/semi-fixed restoration and removable denture restoration are recommended.

source_handle: Explain the condition, keep the patient and family informed, ask for consideration, and choose a day for treatment.
